fact: The Ministry of Industry and Commerce published its external trade statistics report for January-June 2024 in July 2024, compiled from the Janela Unica Electronica (customs single window) and Bank of Mozambique data cross-checked with INE.
title: Relatório do Comércio Externo - 1º Semestre - 2024
publisher: Ministério da Indústria e Comércio, Direcção Nacional do Comércio Externo
